pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How does the voice move in the fourth tone? (1 mark)
   A. It falls sharply
   B. It dips and rises
   C. It rises
   D. It stays flat

2. What does 您好 (nín hǎo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Hello (polite)
   B. You
   C. I, me
   D. To be called

3. Which Chinese word means "this"? (1 mark)
   A. 妹妹 mèimei
   B. 那 nà
   C. 哥哥 gēge
   D. 这 zhè

4. What does 那 (nà) mean? (1 mark)
   A. That
   B. Older brother
   C. Older sister
   D. Younger brother

5. Read the pinyin: zhè shì wǒ māma. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. That is my older brother.
   B. There are five people in my family.
   C. This is my mother.
   D. This is my father.

6. In the sentence 电视在桌子上, where is the television? (1 mark)
   A. On the table
   B. In the kitchen
   C. Under the table
   D. Beside the door

7. Read the pinyin: jīntiān xīngqīsān. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Saturday I rest at home.
   B. Today is Wednesday.
   C. On Friday, go to the mosque.
   D. On Sunday, go to church.

8. What does 星期五 (xīngqīwǔ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Mosque
   B. Friday
   C. Seven
   D. To rest

9. Which sentence means "My birthday is on 5 March."? (1 mark)
   A. 朋友送我礼物。
   B. 你生日是几月几号?
   C. 我的生日是三月五号。
   D. 我们切蛋糕。

10. What does 苹果 (píngguǒ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Apple
   B. Drinks
   C. Chicken (meat)
   D. Meat

11. Which is a good step for reading a sentence at a good pace? (1 mark)
   A. Read only the first word
   B. Read without looking
   C. Read as fast as you can at once
   D. Read slowly first, then join the words and speed up

12. What does 早上好 zǎoshang hǎo mean? (1 mark)
   A. Thank you
   B. Good night
   C. Good morning
   D. Goodbye

13. Which Chinese word means "love"? (1 mark)
   A. 有 yǒu
   B. 爱 ài
   C. 谁 shéi
   D. 姐姐 jiějie

14. What does 吗 ma do at the end of a sentence? (1 mark)
   A. It makes a yes-or-no question
   B. It means and
   C. It means mother
   D. It ends a list

15. What does the small mark 、 do in a list? (1 mark)
   A. It shows a tone
   B. It separates items in the list
   C. It ends a sentence
   D. It asks a question

16. Which word is pronounced jiàotáng? (1 mark)
   A. 教堂
   B. 明天
   C. 去
   D. 清真寺

17. What does 教堂 jiàotáng mean? (1 mark)
   A. Mosque
   B. School
   C. Church
   D. House

18. What does 鸡肉 (jīròu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Chicken (meat)
   B. Apple
   C. Grapes
   D. Fruit (as a group)

19. Fill the blank: 我____吃香蕉。 (I like to eat bananas.) (1 mark)
   A. 在
   B. 有
   C. 喜欢
   D. 不是

20. What does 两 liǎng mean in 两只眼睛? (1 mark)
   A. Two
   B. One
   C. Three
   D. Big

21. Which character has an extra dot compared with 大? (1 mark)
   A. 太
   B. 入
   C. 天
   D. 人

22. How many strokes does the character 十 have? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 3
   C. 2
   D. 1

23. What does 客厅 (kètīng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Where
   B. Cat
   C. Living room
   D. Is at, is in

24. What does 眼睛 (yǎnjing) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Eye
   B. Tooth
   C. Shoulder
   D. Ear

25. What does 洗手 (xǐshǒu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Ear
   B. To wash hands
   C. Two (before a counting word)
   D. Tooth

26. On which vowel is the tone mark in zuǐba? (1 mark)
   A. u
   B. a
   C. i
   D. No vowel

27. Which Chinese word means "rain"? (1 mark)
   A. 天气 tiānqì
   B. 刮风 guā fēng
   C. 雨 yǔ
   D. 没有 méiyǒu

28. What does 刮风 (guā fēng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Not
   B. Snow
   C. Small
   D. The wind blows

29. What does 雪 (xuě) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Cloud
   B. Snow
   C. Flood
   D. There is not

30. What does 门 (mén) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Left side
   B. Bedroom
   C. Door
   D. Above

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The bed is in the bedroom." (2 marks)

32. Rearrange and translate: 浴室 / 花园 / 旁边 / 在. (3 marks)

33. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: míngtiān shì xīngqīsì. (2 marks)

34. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Happy birthday to you!" (3 marks)

35. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "My birthday is on 5 March." (3 marks)

36. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: nà shì wǒ dìdi. (2 marks)

37. Describe how to make the character 手 using local materials. (3 marks)

38. Explain the job of the apostrophe in the word nǚ'ér. (2 marks)

39. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is my mother." (2 marks)

40. Put these words in order and translate: 在 / 电视 / 上 / 桌子. (3 marks)

41. Write the first two strokes of 右 and the first two strokes of 左. (3 marks)

42. Write two foods from each group: fruit and meat, with pinyin. (3 marks)

43. Describe where three things are in a house using 在. Write the Chinese and the meaning. (4 marks)

44. Explain the sentence pattern for saying where something is, with an example. (3 marks)

45. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Today there are clouds." (2 marks)

46. Write two sentences about your family with 这是, and give pinyin. (3 marks)

47. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I like to eat bananas." (3 marks)

48. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is my older sister." and "Who is this?" (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #11 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — It falls sharply
   The fourth tone falls quickly from high to low.

2. A — Hello (polite)
   您好 (nín hǎo) means hello (polite).

3. D — 这 zhè
   这 (zhè) means this.

4. A — That
   那 (nà) means that.

5. C — This is my mother.
   zhè shì wǒ māma. is 这是我妈妈。, which means "This is my mother.".

6. A — On the table
   上 means on.

7. B — Today is Wednesday.
   jīntiān xīngqīsān. is 今天星期三。, which means "Today is Wednesday.".

8. B — Friday
   星期五 (xīngqīwǔ) means Friday.

9. C — 我的生日是三月五号。
   我的生日是三月五号。 (wǒ de shēngrì shì sān yuè wǔ hào.) means "My birthday is on 5 March.".

10. A — Apple
   苹果 (píngguǒ) means apple.

11. D — Read slowly first, then join the words and speed up
   Slow reading first, then a natural speed.

12. C — Good morning
   早上 is morning and 好 is good.

13. B — 爱 ài
   爱 (ài) means love.

14. A — It makes a yes-or-no question
   电视在桌子上吗? asks whether the television is on the table.

15. B — It separates items in the list
   、 is the list comma.

16. A — 教堂
   教堂 is pronounced jiàotáng and means church.

17. C — Church
   教堂 is a church.

18. A — Chicken (meat)
   鸡肉 (jīròu) means chicken (meat).

19. C — 喜欢
   喜欢 means to like.

20. A — Two
   两 is two when counting things.

21. A — 太
   太 is 大 with an extra dot.

22. C — 2
   十 has 横 and 竖.

23. C — Living room
   客厅 (kètīng) means living room.

24. A — Eye
   眼睛 (yǎnjing) means eye.

25. B — To wash hands
   洗手 (xǐshǒu) means to wash hands.

26. C — i
   In ui the second vowel takes the mark.

27. C — 雨 yǔ
   雨 (yǔ) means rain.

28. D — The wind blows
   刮风 (guā fēng) means the wind blows.

29. B — Snow
   雪 (xuě) means snow.

30. C — Door
   门 (mén) means door.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: 床在卧室。 chuáng zài wòshì.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: 浴室在花园旁边。 The bathroom is beside the garden.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for the meaning.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: Tomorrow is Thursday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: 祝你生日快乐! zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我的生日是三月五号。 wǒ de shēngrì shì sān yuè wǔ hào.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: That is my younger brother.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: Choose pebbles, sand, maize grains, sticks or plasticine. Lay out each stroke in the correct order: 撇, 横, 横, 竖钩. Check the order with a partner.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the material, 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for checking.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: It shows where one syllable ends and the next begins, nǚ + ér.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each part of the explanation.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是我妈妈。 zhè shì wǒ māma.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: 电视在桌子上。 The television is on the table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。and pinyin optional, 1 mark for the meaning.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: 右: 撇 then 横. 左: 横 then 撇.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct stroke pair and 1 mark for the difference.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Fruit: 芒果 mángguǒ, 香蕉 xiāngjiāo. Meat: 牛肉 niúròu, 鸡肉 jīròu.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for fruit, 1 mark for meat, 1 mark for correct pinyin.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: 床在卧室 (the bed is in the bedroom); 冰箱在厨房 (the fridge is in the kitchen); 电视在客厅 (the television is in the living room).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for the meanings.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Thing + 在 + place, with 上 or 下 at the end when needed. For example 电视在桌子上。
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the pattern, 1 mark for the example, 1 mark for the translation.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: 今天有云。 jīntiān yǒu yún.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example 这是我爸爸。 zhè shì wǒ bàba. 这是我妈妈。 zhè shì wǒ māma.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence, 1 mark for correct pinyin.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我喜欢吃香蕉。 wǒ xǐhuan chī xiāngjiāo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

48. (4 marks)
   Answer: 这是我姐姐。 zhè shì wǒ jiějie. 这是谁? zhè shì shéi?
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.
